ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) across ~80% of surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels accounting for ~20%, primarily localized at the distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark-intensity region across the proximal and central areas. Distal tips (lateral lobes) exhibit high-contrast light-grey mottling. The left distal tip shows a large light-grey geometric blob with internal dark punctate spots. The right distal tip shows fragmented light-grey banding extending from the trailing edge inward.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch at the central axis, estimated at 130-140 degrees with a shallow vertical depth relative to lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serration (peaks and valleys) along the entire span of the trailing edge, creating a jagged boundary against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, characterized by irregular jagged interruptions.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters detected on the dark surface of the left lobe and proximal regions, consistent with scar tissue.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine, unaligned linear light-grey pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the dark surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable jagged erosion and irregular notches along the trailing edge; distinct linear rake marks visible on the mid-section of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly asymmetrical pigmentation pattern on the distal tips, particularly the dense white mottling concentrated at the outer extremities.
